bind_notes: Tasha currently has NO starting team anywhere in the project: protagonist_canon.json / protagonist_canon.gd define her identity and 6-ball rig only, and the pack tree (files/pokemon-full/playable-kanto/) contains no Tasha team data. The only starting-party mechanism in the game today is the single Lv5 starter choice (campaign/starters.json: Bulbasaur/Charmander/Squirtle) via CampaignFlow.choose_starter, which also refuses a second starter. Binding this team therefore needs a Tasha-specific starting-party grant at bind time (her six records placed directly into her new-game party), not a starters.json edit.

CampaignFlow.build_starter builds IV 0 / EV 0 mons with no ability, nature, or held item. This record's extended fields carry the spec's builds; the binding lane must apply them (or extend the builder) rather than letting them drop.

Eviolite is real and implemented in the staged item work (code_prep_items and code_prep_items_hooks item_engine.gd: 1.5x Def/SpD while the holder can still evolve; also in the item registry and Showdown items data, num 538). It is held by slots 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, all unevolved, and works as specified on each. Slot 3 originally also listed Eviolite, which would have done nothing on a fully-evolved Scizor; Riley resolved that himself on 2026-11-23 22:40 CST by giving Scizor a Metal Coat instead (held data num 233). Closed.
format: 6v6 Singles Nuzlocke starter team, all Level 5
gimmick_notes: Spec's gimmick section recorded as-is and checked against canon: Mega Scizor exists (stone gimmick-gated, unavailable in Kanto); Dynamax/Z-Moves/Terastallization follow the locked per-progression gimmick-unlock canon - none are available at a Kanto start, and no team member has a Gigantamax form. Nothing in the team record depends on a gimmick.
party_mon_shape: Project party-member shape (campaign/campaign_flow.gd build_starter: species_id, name, level, types, base_stats, hp, max_hp, status, moves[{name, pp, max_pp}]) extended with the competitive fields the spec requires (nature, ability, ability_slot, ivs, evs, held_item, computed stats). NOTE for the binding lane: build_starter itself builds IV 0 / EV 0 with no ability, nature, or item; this record's extended fields must be consumed at bind time, not dropped.

team.ev_cap_note: 508 of PUW's locked 510 cap allocated; 2 points unspent, exactly as the spec intends (the last 2 points buy no stat at any level). Legal.
team.hidden_ability_note: Newest held data (PKHeX SV personal + Showdown Gen 9 pokedex) gives Piplup's hidden ability as Competitive. The spec listed Defiant, which was Piplup's hidden ability in Gens 5-8 (PKHeX BDSP/LA personal confirm Defiant there). Tasha's Piplup runs Torrent either way; only the HA field is corrected. See DISCREPANCIES.md D4.
team.moves_verified: Gen 9 (SV) level-up: Pound L1, Growl L4 - both known at Level 5. Spec's upcoming list also verified exact against Gen 9: Water Gun L8, Charm L11, Peck L15, Bubble Beam L18.
team.name: piplup

team.ability_note: The spec lists Rough Skin as the ability and Sand Veil as the alternative. Held data (PKHeX SV/BDSP/SwSh personal, Showdown pokedex) is the other way round: Sand Veil is the regular ability, Rough Skin is the HIDDEN ability. The build is unchanged - Tasha's Gible has Rough Skin - but it is recorded here as the hidden-ability slot, which is what it is. See DISCREPANCIES.md D3.
team.moves_verified: Gen 9 (SV) level-up: Tackle L1, Sand Tomb L1 - both known at Level 5. Spec's upcoming list verified exact against Gen 9: Sand Attack L6, Dragon Breath L12, Bulldoze L18, Bite L25.
team.name: gible

team.ability_note: Technician is Scizor's regular slot-1 ability (PKHeX SV personal abilities [Swarm, Technician, Light Metal]; Showdown pokedex agrees). Same ability the spec picked for Scyther, and it is equally legal on Scizor.
team.exception_note: RILEY CORRECTION 2026-11-23 22:39 CST, full spec 22:40 CST: slot 3 is SCIZOR, not Scyther - 'she should have Scizor and is the exception.' Scizor is the team's one exception to the Basic/Unevolved rule: Tasha starts with it already evolved at Level 5. DO NOT 'fix' this slot back to Scyther. No evolution entry for this slot.
team.held_item_note: Riley resolved the slot 3 item himself (2026-11-23 22:40 CST): Metal Coat, not Eviolite. Metal Coat is real in held item data (Showdown items num 233: boosts the holder's Steel-type moves). It is live on this build - Bullet Punch is Steel-type. The earlier Eviolite-on-Scizor flag is CLOSED, resolved by Riley; see DISCREPANCIES.md D1.
team.mega_note: Mega Scizor verified in held data (Showdown pokedex scizormega): base stats 70/150/140/65/100/75, BST 600, ability Technician - exactly as Riley listed. Its Mega Stone remains gimmick-gated by canon (no gimmicks in Kanto); unavailable at a Kanto start. Recorded, not changed.
team.moves_verified: All four verified as SCIZOR's own moves at Level 5 in the newest held data (PKHeX SV learnset + Showdown Gen 9): Bullet Punch level 0 (learned on evolution; Showdown L1 in Gens 4-7), Fury Cutter L1, Wing Attack L1, Quick Attack L1. No Scyther pre-evolution inheritance is needed for any of them - each is native to Scizor at or below Level 5. Also in Scizor's SV Level 1 set, not taken: Leer, False Swipe, Agility, Air Slash.
team.name: scizor
team.stats_note: Computed with the standard stat formula (project team_builder.gd _compute_stats) from the spec's IVs/EVs/Adamant. Riley's stated line (26/24/16/10/14/13) matches the formula on five of six stats; Special Attack is 9 by formula, not 10 - Adamant's 0.9x applies after the +5 (floor(110*5/100)=5, +5=10, floor(10*0.9)=9). Record carries the formula value. See DISCREPANCIES.md D7.

team.name: corphish
